verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents an Audit Logs product for emitting and exporting events, kept as a compliance and security paper trail. Its pricing lists per-SIEM-connection log streaming, so the capture, export and SIEM-streaming core is first-party. Events appear to be app-emitted rather than automatically captured auth or admin activity, and nothing documents tamper-evidence. missing for 10: evidence of tamper-evident or immutable log integrity, explicit automatic capture of authentication and admin events, detailed SIEM streaming docs (supported destinations, format), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can capture tamper-evident audit logs of authentication and admin activity and stream or export them to my SIEM
